rules.statement: A constructive trust may be held to have been created if the Court can infer from the attendant circumstances that the owner did not intend to dispose of the beneficial interest in the property at the time the legal interest was transferred to the transferee.
rules.supporting_quote: Where the Court can infer, as contemplated by section 83, from the “attendant circumstances”, namely the circumstances which precede or follow the transfer, that the owner did not intend to dispose of the beneficial interest in the property at the time the legal interest was transferred to the transferee, a constructive trust may be held to have been created.
